families.page_title: Management of tuberculosis in secure settings in England
evidence_points: The publication supports custodial, healthcare, NHS TB and health-protection teams working in secure settings.
It covers detection, notification, case management and incident or outbreak response.
The scope includes prisons, young offender institutions, approved premises and immigration detention settings in England.
The current combined guidance replaced earlier separate prison and health-protection documents.

families.page_title: Notifying suspected or confirmed active tuberculosis (TB)
evidence_points: The guidance is for registered medical practitioners and others responsible for notifying active TB.
All suspected and confirmed active TB is statutorily notifiable irrespective of disease site.
Notification is made electronically through the National TB Surveillance System.
Timely notification supports investigation, risk assessment, cluster detection and outbreak response.

families.topic: pre-entry screening, LTBI testing, contact tracing and BCG activity in 2024
evidence_points: The chapter reports UK pre-entry TB screening, new-entrant LTBI testing, contact tracing and BCG activity for 2024.
It states that 40,490 eligible new entrants were tested for LTBI in 2024.
It reports that contact screening identified active TB and latent TB infection among contacts.
Treatment-completion and some screening figures include missing-data and reporting-delay caveats.
